program_solutions:
(rule!
  (reduce (lambda (out obj)
    (if (not (= (obj-color obj) 7)) out
      (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
             (touch-top (any? (lambda (p) (= (fst p) 0)) cells))
             (touch-left (any? (lambda (p) (= (snd p) 0)) cells)))
        (if (and touch-top touch-left)
          (recolor-cells out cells 8)
          out))))
    g (objects g 0)))
